objective: Compare original EditScore/EditReward with task-grounded verification on practical attribute editing and replacement requests. Identify natural failures and measure any selection improvement before claiming policy-learning gains.
candidate_policy: Every initial candidate comes from the same untrained official Qwen-Image-2.1 pipeline. No synthetic degradation.
labels: Assistant visual review before reading reward scores, not independent human annotations. Preserve per-criterion evidence and uncertainty.
evaluation: Compare top-1 selection and within-task pair ordering. Freeze task-grounded scoring choices using development sources before inspecting heldout scores. Report ties, failures, and tiny sample limits.
scope_note: Best-of-N/agent improvements are inference-time improvements and must not be reported as RL weight-training gains.
retry: One extra four-seed development-only retry with explicit feedback. Evaluated against the original request; not included in heldout top-1 metrics.
annotation_correction: After heldout inspection, v3 fixes a cream-frame patch which overlapped editable upholstery. Preserve v2 frozen scores separately; report v3 as exploratory annotation-corrected results. No scalar hyperparameters were changed.
